taskAndRubricVerdict.physicsCorrectness: For the stated constant-mass, inertial-frame, constant-net-force, straight-line start from rest, net work equals the kinetic-energy increase, V=aT and the triangular velocity-time area yields distance TV/2. Substitution gives one-half mV squared; the fixed-mass square scaling follows correctly. No spatial quantity arrows are part of the stimulus.
taskAndRubricVerdict.clarityAndCoachChat: The task specifies the physical assumptions, required derivation, graphic justification and speed-dependence question. An accurate labelled graph and an unambiguous verbal account of axes, units, line, endpoint and area have equal standing, so a learner can complete it in text chat. No image rendering or external visit is needed.
taskAndRubricVerdict.weightsAndThreshold: A-D each carry three points. With a total-only threshold of 10/12, entirely missing or zeroed carrying performance leaves at most nine and therefore fails without a separate gate. Partial evidence remains creditable, including A=1.5 in S02/S04. S04 passes exactly at ten; S06 fails at 9.5. The weights therefore make every whole performance consequential while allowing limited partial evidence or minor slips.
taskAndRubricVerdict.misconceptionsAndRetractions: S07-S10 and S18 apply the stated performance-level zero to explicitly maintained misconceptions. Correct formulas do not cancel those assertions. S16 demonstrates that an express retraction earns full current credit. There is no extra pass/fail condition beyond the resulting points.
taskAndRubricVerdict.minorSlips: S03 and S13 pass with one isolated 0.5 slip. S04 passes with partial A plus one graph-unit slip. S06 fairly separates a result-unit slip in B from an independently miswritten graph unit in C, producing 9.5. Missing conceptual evidence is handled by its allocation, rather than by an extra slip penalty.
taskAndRubricVerdict.equivalentMethodsAndRepresentations: The aT-squared route in S15 and the unfactored but equivalent final expression in S17 receive full B. Complete verbal graph descriptions receive full C wherever present. A physically accurate drawn graph meeting the same content criteria would also earn full C; no actual raster or vector drawing was supplied among the blind scripts, so this review makes no image-inspection claim. Missing axis arrowheads alone carry no penalty under the native text.
taskAndRubricVerdict.translation: The two task versions and their native scoring paragraphs are substantively aligned in assumptions, evidence allocations, follow-through, misconceptions, retraction, slip policy and threshold. All 18 paired submissions receive identical scores. The English velocity wording is compatible with the given unidirectional motion and the German speed magnitude; it creates no material scoring difference.
taskAndRubricVerdict.ambiguityAssessment: No material ambiguity affecting the 18 supplied cases or the score-only threshold was found. The result-unit slip in S03/S06 is assigned once to B because it occurs in the stated result of the derivation, whereas the independent graph-unit slip is expressly assigned to C. The explicit unit evidence prevents either from being mistaken for a maintained misconception.

independence: Original independent marking by an agent that did not author this task. Read only candidate.goal.json, task-and-marking.md and the supplied blind directory. No author material, other marker marks, prior reviews or reconciliation were read.
caseHashCanonicalization: Per-case SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(original_case, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma, colon)); response hashes use the exact decoded response string encoded as UTF-8.
